report:
QA crawler: 762 Playwright visits covering every route from apps/web/src/app/**/page.tsx (107 page files, 113 URLs once dynamic segments are filled with real API ids: rounds 1248 open / 1247 settled / 1245 cancelled, WD-20931, nova's user id de000001-…048213, KYC case 5c774aff-…, admin withdrawal f74c0f15-…, all 4 restricted variants, /admin/games for the admin catch-all). Seven identities (guest, @nova.k, a brand-new not-onboarded player, Super Admin, Finance, Compliance, Support), each at 1440×900 and 390×844.

Run: production build in .next-qa-crawler (NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api) on :3301, against an API compiled to apps/api/.dev/dist-qa-crawler on :4301 (JOBS_ENABLED=false, high throttles, shared dev DB). Everything I report, I observed in this run or checked with a direct probe. Screenshots, the per-visit report and an aggregated summary with a coverage table are in /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/test-results/visual/qa-crawl/ (report.json, summary.txt, <role>/<slug>_<w>.png; 763 PNGs).

Headline result: the shell and the pages are technically clean — 0 uncaught page errors, 0 5xx, 0 network failures, 0 horizontal overflow at either width. The breakage is in the data wiring between modules:
- The shell and the homepage still show @nova.k's hard-coded DEMO profile and balance to every signed-in player. These are the two blockers.
- The homepage and the pool module disagree about whether round #1,248 is open.
- A not-onboarded player gets "Something went wrong" on all responsible-gaming pages.
- The onboarding Terms and Privacy links lead to 404 pages.
- The seed data contradicts itself (settled rounds with 0 participants but "threshold met"; nova seeded over her own daily loss limit).
- 50 link targets do not exist. Their RSC prefetch 404s cause 2,950 console errors.

Coverage (rows = routes, columns = G guest | N nova | NP new player | SA | F | C | S; ok = 200 at both widths; >X = ended on X; >onb = /onboarding?next=…; !skel = skeletons still showing after 10 s; !err = visible error state; !noperm = "Your role can't open this page"; - = not applicable):
/ ok|ok|>onb · /2fa >/2fa/setup (G,N,NP) · /2fa/challenge, /2fa/setup ok|ok|ok · /account and 10 sub-pages ok|ok|>onb, except /account/kyc/verify ok!skel|ok|>onb · /auth-preview 404|404|404 (dev-only page, expected in a prod build) · /dashboard, /notifications, all 13 /history/* pages, all 9 /pool/* pages incl. 1248/1247/1245 and their verify pages, /provably-fair, all 7 /wallet/* pages incl. /wallet/withdraw/WD-20931: ok|ok|>onb · /favourites, /recently-played, /history, /transactions: redirect to their /history/* targets (G,N), >onb (NP) · /onboarding ok|ok|ok · /responsible-gaming and its 6 sub-pages ok|ok|ok!err · /restricted ok!skel|ok|ok!skel · /restricted/{suspended,under-review,self-excluded,region} ok|ok|ok · /sign-in, /sign-up ok|>/|>onb · /verify >/sign-up|>/|>onb · /design-system ok!skel (G only; the catalogue shows skeletons on purpose) · /design-system/shell ok (G only).
/admin: G >login; SA, F, C, S ok · /admin/login: G ok; every admin role >/admin · /admin/finance/withdrawals: G >login; all admin roles ok · /admin/compliance >/admin/compliance/kyc for all roles (F !noperm) · /admin/compliance/aml: F and S !noperm · /admin/compliance/kyc and /kyc/:id: F !noperm · /admin/finance/{fees,ledger,pool-accounting,reconciliation,refunds,reports}: C and S !noperm (correct for their roles) · /admin/pool/refunds: C and S !noperm (incorrect, issue #8). All other admin routes ok for SA, F, C and S: /admin alerts, approvals, audit, roles, permissions, no-access, games; finance deposits, withdrawals and withdrawals/:id; the 10 /admin/pool/* pages; /admin/users and the 9 /admin/users/:id/* tabs.

Shell link check on 3 representative pages per identity (player: /, /wallet, /pool; admin: /admin, /admin/users, /admin/finance/withdrawals), both widths:
- Player sidebar: 16 of 25 links dead. Footer: 25 of 34. Topbar: /search. Mobile tab bar: "Games" → /originals. Mobile drawer: 16 of 26.
- Player user menu: 5 of 5 links valid.
- Admin sidebar: 4 links (SA) / 2 (other roles) go to the "module not built" catch-all. Admin topbar, mobile tab bar and user menu links are all valid.

Housekeeping:
- I killed only my own processes (web 19258, API 16559 and its wrapper shell 16556) and deleted apps/web/.next-qa-crawler and apps/api/.dev/dist-qa-crawler.
- `next build` adds ".next-qa-crawler/types/**/*.ts" to apps/web/tsconfig.json; I removed that line and git now shows no tsconfig diff.
- No application code was edited and nothing was committed.
- Shared dev DB side effects: 4 throwaway, never-onboarded DEV MOCK players (did:privy:qa-crawler-mx008vc620c4bf, plus probe players did:privy:qa-probe-*, qa-probe-shell-*, qa-crawler-probe-*) and normal admin login/refresh and session rows. Nothing else was written.
- Rerun after fixes: `node apps/web/scripts/qa-crawler.mjs` (setup steps are at the top of the file; DRY=1 prints the URL list). It exits 1 while problems remain.
- Memory: the stored note (Figma design file) did not bear on this task, so no facts here come from memory. Possibly worth saving: "integration QA crawler lives at apps/web/scripts/qa-crawler.mjs (ports 3301/4301)" — learned in this session.

report:
QA "journeys" (web :3302, API :4302): integration results

I wrote six cross-module Playwright journeys plus a shared helper under apps/web/e2e/integration/ and ran them against the shared dev DB at 1440×1024 and at 390×844 (E2E_VIEWPORT=390). Each run uses a fresh player.

**Result: every core money, compliance and four-eyes step passes, at both widths.** The specs are still red, because each one ends on soft assertions that record real integration bugs (listed in `issues`). The exception is J6: the API has no way to drive a round through close → draw → settle, so that part is skipped, and its verifier step fails.

**Setup**
- Services: `bash scripts/dev-services.sh start`.
- Web build: `flock /tmp/gp-web-build.lock env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-qa-journeys NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4302 NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:4302 pnpm --filter @gp/web build` → exit 0.
- API compile: `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir .dev/dist-qa-journeys`, run from apps/api.
- API run: `API_PORT=4302 APP_URL=http://localhost:3302 CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3302 JOBS_ENABLED=false THROTTLE_LIMIT=3000 DEV_TOKEN_THROTTLE_LIMIT=2000 ADMIN_LOGIN_THROTTLE_LIMIT=300 node .dev/dist-qa-journeys/src/main.js`.
- Web run: `NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-qa-journeys pnpm exec next start -p 3302`.
- Code snapshot: the API was compiled at about 05:56 UTC and the web built at about 06:00 UTC. Other agents (api-a, api-b, web closeout) have changed code since, so some findings may already be fixed upstream.

**Commands**
- Run all journeys: `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3302 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:4302 pnpm --filter @gp/web exec playwright test e2e/integration --output test-results/e2e-journeys`.
- Mobile run: add `E2E_VIEWPORT=390` and use `--output test-results/e2e-journeys-390`.
- `eslint e2e/integration` is clean, and tsc reports no errors in e2e/integration.

**Admin 2FA codes.** Other agents use the same DEMO admins at the same time, and each TOTP step is accepted only once per admin. The helper therefore reads `totp_secrets.last_used_step` from the DB and only submits an unused step. This avoided failed attempts and lockouts for everyone.

**Timing.** Before 08:00 UTC, J1, J2 and J6 failed at the entry step because round #1248 was not accepting entries (the first blocker below). Everything was re-run after 08:00.

**Results per journey** (hard assertions; soft assertions are the bugs)

- **J1 new player: PASS on all hard steps at 1440 and 390.**
  - Sign-up with email and code works; 000000 shows "attempts left".
  - Onboarding: every checkbox starts unchecked, and submitting without them shows the consent error.
  - Dashboard checklist shows "1 of 4 complete". KYC Level 1 is approved (API level_1).
  - DEMO deposit: 0/20 confirmations gives pending 100.00, then it is credited after 20 (100.00/0/0/0, total 100.00).
  - 3 entries: breakdown 30.00 + platform fee 0.15 on its own line ("3 × 0.05 … not added to the pool"), network fee 0.00, total 30.15, 69.85 after. Consent starts unchecked and Confirm stays disabled until it is ticked. The receipt shows an EP- reference.
  - Wallet (API and UI): Available 69.85, Locked 30.00, Total 99.85.
  - History: `/history/fees` has one line `{kind: platform_fee, amount: 0.15}`. The transactions API has the entry as amount 30.00, platformFee 0.15, netAmount 30.15. The UI shows "Entries 30.00 + fee 0.15", the fee page shows −0.15, `/pool/entries` shows "30.00 + 0.15 fee", and the dashboard Active state shows 69.85 / 99.85.
  - Soft failures: the top-bar balance, and the lobby showing another player's data.
- **J2 responsible gaming: PASS on all hard steps at both widths.**
  - The 20.00 daily limit applies at once.
  - The dialog says "This would exceed your daily participation limit: 0.00 + 30.15 = 30.15 of 20.00 USDT.", offers "Reduce to 1 entry", and Confirm is disabled.
  - The API answers `422 RG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` and the balance is unchanged.
  - Raising to 50.00 is pending with effectiveAt about +24 h; the limit stays 20.00 and the API still answers 422.
  - The 24 h break works: entries and deposits get `403 SELF_EXCLUDED` (kind cooling_off).
  - A 25.00 withdrawal is submitted during the break and goes under review (75.00 / 25.00).
  - Soft failures: Participate and the deposit flow are not blocked up front during the break.
- **J3 withdrawal + four-eyes: PASS on all hard steps at both widths.**
  - TOTP enrolment through the UI works.
  - Whitelisting works only after a workaround (bug below). The address then shows "Cooling down", and using it gives `422 ADDRESS_NOT_WHITELISTED`.
  - Review trigger: a withdrawal of 150.00 to a NEW address is flagged by the AML new-destination rule. The other rules are ≥10,000.00 USDT or ≥5 withdrawals in 24 h.
  - The manual-review screen appears. A wrong step-up code is rejected, the right one gives `under_review` (350.00 / 150.00), and the tracker shows the review.
  - Finance (A. Marin) gives step 1 of 2; the status stays under_review. Self-approval is disabled in the UI and the API answers 403 "different admin".
  - Compliance (K. Osei) gives step 2; the status becomes queued and the tracker says "Approved — waiting to be sent".
  - The DEMO confirmation settles it as confirmed: 350.00 / 0.00, total 350.00. History shows completed, 150.00 − fee 0.08 = 149.92.
  - The admin detail shows both admins. Reconciliation: `{ok: true, ledgerTotal: 0.00, unbalancedPostings: 0, poolMismatches: []}`.
- **J4 admin restriction: PASS on all hard steps at both widths.**
  - The Super Admin's request goes to pending four-eyes and nothing changes yet. Self-approval is blocked.
  - After Compliance approves, account-status shows `restrictions: [withdrawals_frozen]` and `paused: {gaming: false, deposits: false, withdrawals: true}`.
  - Withdrawal → 403; deposit → 200; a pool entry is not refused with 403.
  - The audit log has S. Iyer `approval.requested`, K. Osei `approval.approved`, and K. Osei `user.restriction.applied`. "Hash chain intact" is shown and `/admin/audit-logs/verify` returns ok.
  - Soft failures: /restricted and /wallet/withdraw do not show the hold.
- **J5 self-exclusion: PASS on all hard steps at both widths.**
  - The acknowledgement starts unchecked. The button stays locked until the phrase is exact (lowercase is rejected), the box is ticked and the 2FA code is entered.
  - A 6-month exclusion becomes active.
  - Entries, deposits and the deposit address get 403 SELF_EXCLUDED.
  - A 20.00 withdrawal goes through under review.
  - A shorter break or self-exclusion is refused with 409.
  - /restricted redirects to /restricted/self-excluded, which is correct at 1440 and 390.
  - Soft failures: sign-in lands on the lobby, and Participate and the deposit flow are not blocked up front.
- **J6 round lifecycle:**
  - Test 1 PASS: a fresh player buys 2 entries (20.00 + 0.10, network 0.00, total 20.10; 29.90 / 20.00), the round page shows the entry id, and /history/games/active lists the round.
  - Test 2 SKIPPED: there is no DEMO/dev helper for close → draw → settle; the likely endpoints were probed and all return 404.
  - Test 3 FAIL: every settled round in the dev DB is a DEMO snapshot with `randomness: null`, so the in-browser verifier shows "Nothing to verify yet". A player's result and winnings in history could not be tested.

**Evidence** (all under apps/web/test-results/, which is git-ignored)
- Step screenshots and per-journey `*_signals.json` (console errors and failing requests): e2e-journeys-shots/. Mobile files carry a `_390` suffix.
- Failure artifacts: e2e-journeys/ and e2e-journeys-390/.
- Screenshots preserved from before 08:00 UTC: e2e-journeys-evidence/.
- Some early screenshots were overwritten by the final run. Where an issue cites "observed at 06:xx UTC", the API response and run-log evidence is given instead.

**Cleanup.** My web (pids 18617/18632) and API (pid 16594) processes are stopped, and `.next-qa-journeys` and `.dev/dist-qa-journeys` are deleted. Nothing was committed and no application code was edited.

**Worth remembering** (learned this session; none of it came from stored memory, and the stored Figma notes were not relevant):
1. A night-time DEMO seed leaves round #1248 "open" but refusing entries until 08:00 UTC, so pool e2e tests (including apps/web/e2e/pool.spec.ts) fail between 00:00 and 08:00 UTC.
2. The DEMO admins' TOTP steps are shared across concurrent agents. Pick a step greater than `totp_secrets.last_used_step`.
